source.notes: ICSE Class 8 school final examination physics paper (school not named), scanned with no text layer. Header prints 'FINAL EXAMINATION (2025-2026)', 'PHYSICS', 'CLASS: 8', 'READING TIME: 15 Minutes', 'DATE: 12.02.2026', 'TOTAL MARKS: 80', 'WRITING TIME: 2 Hours' (durationMinutes 120 = writing time). examYear 2026 from the printed date (file name says 020326-feb-2026). Section A (compulsory: Q1 [15], Q2, Q3) and Section B ('Attempt any four questions', Q4-Q9). Q1 prints only a group total [15] for its fifteen MCQs, so it is one entry with that total; Q2(i) likewise one [6] entry; other sub-questions carry printed marks. The Section B any-4-of-6 choice cannot be expressed with choiceGroup, so all six are included: entries add up to 100 against 80 (40 + 4 x 10). Student handwriting, ticks and circles on the scan (e.g. answers written beside Q5(i), Q8) were ignored. No answer key is printed.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
